label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
@ReneeK_Meyerland @MarisolB

Renee, I'm sorry your toe hurt. I mean that. You have been our customer for 2 years, and I never wanted this for you. I am writing because I want to tell you what happened from our side, and I will try to stay calm and just say the facts.

You came in Saturday, October 24 for a deluxe pedicure, $45. Your technician was my niece Vy. She is licensed 3 years. She was born in Houston and speaks English fine. Sometimes she is shy, but she understands everything. That part hurt us a lot to read.

About the cleaning, this is how we do it for every customer, every time:

- All metal tools come from the autoclave, in a sealed pouch. We open the pouch in front of the customer.
- The file and buffer are brand new for each person, and the customer takes them home.
- A new plastic liner goes in the pedicure tub for every customer.

We also passed our state inspection in August 2026 with no violations. The paper is on the wall in the salon if anyone wants to see it. We have been open 19 years, and this is the first time anyone has complained to us about an infection. I am not saying it is impossible for something to go wrong. I am saying we take it seriously, and the way we work is clean.

About the cuticle, I want to say it carefully, because I do not want to fight with you. During the service you asked Vy to cut the cuticle more, and more. Vy told you she did not want to cut too much. You said it was fine, that you always do it this way. Vy is a new-ish tech, and she tried to be careful. I do not think anybody was trying to hurt you. But this is what happened in the room, and I think you should hear it from me.

When you came back on November 2 and showed me your red toe, I offered you the full $45 back, and I offered to pay your urgent care copay if you bring the receipt. You asked for $300 cash and a free pedicure every time for one year. I said no to that, and I still say no, because I cannot do that for the salon. But I did not shrug at you, Renee. I offered what I could. That offer is still open today. Bring the receipt and I will pay the copay and refund the $45.

I also want to say something to everyone reading this. Dave, I understand why you said it, but please do not say all nail salons are dirty. Not every place is the same. Many of us work very hard to keep our shops clean, and we are proud of that. My niece read this thread and cried all night. She told me she wants to quit doing nails. She is 3 years in, and she is good at her job. Please remember there are real people behind these shops, many of them young and trying hard.

Marisol, thank you. Thank you for saying something kind and fair, and for asking Renee to talk to me again. You have been coming to us for 4 years, and I really appreciate it. It meant a lot to read your words on a very bad day.

Renee, if you want to talk, please call me at the salon, or come in and sit with me. I would really like to hear everything from you, and I will listen. If you want to file with the state, that is your right, and we will cooperate with anything they need. I only want us to talk like neighbors. I hope your toe gets better soon, and I hope we can fix this.

Thank you for reading.

Lotus Garden Nails, Bellaire
